title: Python: Arithmetic
description: Write a Python program that performs basic arithmetic operations with two numbers.

codeTemplate.py:
a = 15
b = 4

print(f"{a} + {b} = {a + b}")
print(f"{a} - {b} = {a - b}")
print(f"{a} * {b} = {a * b}")
print(f"{a} / {b} = {a / b}")
print(f"{a} // {b} = {a // b}")
print(f"{a} % {b} = {a % b}")
